definitions.body_flat: longest body flat of the route: parts[2] for the 926 lifted routes, parts[0] for the 98 interface-direct routes
definitions.s_mm: arc length along the body flat only; interface leads are excluded
definitions.crossing: frozen E5 crossing_stats.json event (strict D56 legal transverse crossing); mapped to s analytically
definitions.cluster: gap-connected run of one route's crossings, gap=10.000 mm
definitions.candidate: excursion [s0, s1] on one straight line primitive: two R15 S-curves + middle flat at target_z
definitions.estimated_removed: count of the route's source-height crossing events with s in (s0, s1)
definitions.estimated_added: count of OTHER routes' target-height flat crossings with the route XY path inside [s0+f, s1-f]
definitions.transition_clearance: advisory analytic true-3D guard of each R15 S-curve against other routes' flats (0.05 mm clearance plus the l3d-world +0.011 mm sampling safety); feeds world_3d_ok only
definitions.target_spacing: advisory strict-D56 0.08 mm spacing of the new middle flat at target_z against other target-height flats (legal transverse crossings exempted)
definitions.feasible: task definition: one straight-run placement + minimum middle length + 1.25 mm source shadow (plus the strict extra guards used here: landing shadow, no target-height overlap/tangency); the true-3D / D56-spacing re-audit is reported separately as world_3d_ok

approximations: estimated_added counts analytic geometric intersection points of the straight middle run against all other flats at target_z (line/line + line/arc); points are de-duplicated per partner route within 1e-6 mm and only transverse contacts (angle >= 5.0 deg) are counted as crossings; collinear overlaps and tangent contacts are reported separately (never counted as crossings).

estimated_removed counts crossing events in the open interval (s0, s1); feasible candidates have an empty 1.25 mm transition-shadow window at both source-height ends, so every removed event really disappears.

the landing-side (target-height) shadow is checked as an extra feasibility guard (the S-curve is also within 50 um of the target plane near that end); shadow_ok in the schema refers to the source-height rule, target_shadow_ok is reported next to it.

the advisory world_3d_ok flag emulates the frozen 3D world: each R15 S-curve is tested analytically against other routes' flats (0.05 mm clearance + the world accept safety of 0.011 mm) using the exact S-curve height profile, and the middle flat gets a strict-D56 0.08 mm spacing test at target_z. S-curve vs S-curve interactions are not analysed here and are left to the exact world validator.

estimated_added / estimated_removed do not re-audit the strict D56 pair policy, and crossing-window overlaps between several close crossings are not re-audited; the four/more decimal exact numbers must come from the frozen validator.
manual-plane target heights are evaluated (they are among the 21 heights) but flagged with target_is_manual_plane because the frozen manual routes occupy those planes.
one excursion covers one gap-cluster piece on one straight run; multi-excursion routes and batch interactions between simultaneously moved routes are out of scope (experiment B evaluates those).

spot_validation.note: diagnostic only: the deliverable feasible flag is the geometric definition; the exact cache re-audits strict D56 and is the ground truth for experiment B
